Magnetic resonance imaging for volume estimation of large multinodular goitres: a comparison with scintigraphy. As a result of increasing interest in non-surgical treatment for the reduction of goitre size the use of magnetic resonance (MR) imaging for volume estimation of large multinodular goitres was evaluated in 20 patients (three males and 17 females; age 61 +/- 21 years) with a multinodular goitre larger than 100 ml. In addition, MR measurements were compared with scintigraphic (SC) volume estimations. Intraobserver coefficient of variation (CV) of MR measurements was 2.2 +/- 2.0% (Observer 1) and interobserver CV 4.1 +/- 2.2% (Observers 1 and 2).
